headline: I used Codex to connect the new JEV model from TypeSafe, 10 calls a second, to play the game.

media.alt: Video from the post by ロネン・ギラッド

text:
I gave Chrome’s offline dinosaur an online AI brain. 🦖

I used Codex to connect the new JEV model from TypeSafe, 10 calls a second, to play the game.

12 minutes and more than 13,000 points until I stopped it because it looked like it would go on forever.

Good use for AI? Maybe…
